From the Bronx to global icon, Jennifer Lopez blends her hits with personal stories in a dazzling, unforgettable live show.

The JLO Show will premiere Thanksgiving evening, Thursday, November 26 (8:00-10:00 PM, ET/PT) on the CBS Television Network, and stream on Paramount+*, with an extended version available exclusively on Paramount+. 

*Paramount+ Premium plan subscribers will have access to stream live via the live feed of their local CBS affiliate on the service, as well as on-demand. Paramount+ Essential subscribers will not have the option to stream live, but will have access to on-demand.

They all volunteered. Not all of them will make it.

For the first time, cameras go inside U.S. Army Ranger School, where over 61 days, exhaustion, setbacks and relentless pressure push soldiers past every limit. Only those who endure will earn the coveted Ranger Tab.

The new docuseries premieres December 8, exclusively on Paramount+.
